features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description:
The Ancient Fey Court adds spells to your warlock spell list.

| Spell Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | faerie fire, sleep |
| 2nd | calm emotions, phantasmal force |
| 3rd | blink, plant growth |
| 4th | dominate beast, greater invisibility |
| 5th | dominate person, seeming |

features.name: Courtier's Aspect
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, as an action, force all creatures in a 10-ft cube originating from you to make a WIS save (your warlock spell save DC). Until the end of your next turn, creatures that fail are either charmed by you or frightened of you (your choice). 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Courtier's Aspect
payload.description: Force creatures in 10-ft cube to WIS save or be charmed or frightened until end of your next turn.

features.name: Shroud of Mists
features.description: At 6th level, as a reaction after suffering damage, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You become invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or until the start of your next turn. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Shroud of Mists
payload.description: After taking damage, teleport up to 60 ft and become invisible until you attack, cast, or start of your next turn.

features.name: Counter Enchantment
features.description: Starting at 10th level, you gain immunity to the charmed condition. When a creature targets you with a charm effect, you can use your reaction to force it to make a WIS save (your warlock spell save DC). On a failure, it becomes charmed by you for 1 minute, ending if it takes damage.

payload.name: Counter Enchantment
payload.description: When targeted by a charm effect, force the caster to WIS save or become charmed by you for 1 minute (ends if damaged).

features.name: Waking Dream
features.description: Beginning at 14th level, as an action, target a creature within 60 ft (WIS save vs your spell save DC). On failure, it is charmed or frightened (your choice) while you concentrate for up to 1 minute or until it takes damage. The target cannot see or hear other creatures and perceives its surroundings as an illusory realm you control. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Waking Dream
payload.description: Target within 60 ft: WIS save or charmed/frightened (concentration, 1 min). Target perceives illusory realm of your design.
